buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 50% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 50 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 50 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 50 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Payment PAYMENT OF SALARIES AND WAGES: Service Provider is required to pay Salaries / wages of contracted staff deployed at buyer location first i.e. on their own and then claim payment from Buyer alongwith all statutory documents like, PF, ESIC etc. as well as the bank statement of payment done to staff. 3. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 4. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Account Payee Demand Draft in favour of FA & CAO, Eastern Railway, Kolkata payable at Kolkata . Bidder has to upload scanned copy / proof of the DD along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy

to the Buyer within 5 days of Bid End date / Bid Opening date. 5. Buyer Added Bid Specific SLA File Attachment Click here to view the file. 6. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer uploaded ATC document Click here to view the file. 7. Buyer Added Bid Specific Scope Of Work(SOW) Text Clause(s) SCOPE OF WORK & SPECIAL TERMS AND CONDITIONS 1. Vehicle will be utilized for transportation of small sophisticated material and mov ement Officers /staff of Liluah workshop as per requirement. The vehicle will be un der control of Dy. CME (LHB), ER, LLH. 2. Requirement of vehicle is as below: 01 SUV (Maruti Suzuki Ertiga, Mahindra XUV 500, Mahindra Scorpio, KIA Carens et c) Note: Vehicle provided may be of different make/model from the above mentioned m odels but will be accepted only after the approval by Railway authority. 3. The firm shall have to offer the vehicle for inspection prior to commencement of c ontract and get it approved by the railway authority for its conformity to the specifi cation prescribed by the Railway Authority. 4. The vehicle drivers have to report daily at the place as instructed by the Railway authority. The reporting place will be anywhere in Howrah or Kolkata and maximu m at a distance of 100 Km from Howrah Railway Station. Normally, the place of rep orting will be Liluah Railway colony/Liluah Workshop, ER. The account of distance i n kilometres and time will start from the time and place of reporting of the vehicle. The contractor shall be informed in advance about the reporting place. Kilometres earning will be calculated from the reporting place only. 5. Schedule of Vehicle: The vehicle along with driver should be made available for all 24 hours of a day, however, its normal/routine use shall be from 07:30 Hrs. To 1 9:30 hrs. The vehicle should be ready at the place of reporting at least 15 minutes before from the time of reporting. In case of requirement beyond these hours, the vehicle has to be made available accordingly. The vehicle may be called on Sunda ys/Holidays too which has to be complied accordingly on time and place as per req uirement 6. Garage for vehicle shall be arranged by the contractor as per the convenience to the place of reporting. Safe keeping of the vehicle during the contract period is the sole responsibility of the contractor. Railway Administration will not be responsible for any mishaps like theft, breakdown, loss or damage etc. of the vehicle of any kin d whatever it may be at any point of time during the contract period. If requested by the contractor, Railway may provide free parking of the vehicle during ‘OFF’ dut y hours in Railway premises. However, Railway shall have no liability in case of da mage/theft to such parked vehicle. 7. The value of GeM purchase order will include fixed cost of the vehicle per month,

fuel charges, pay/wages of the driver, maintenance, servicing from time to time an d any other seen or unforeseen charges and will be binding upon the service provi der. All and every maintenance expenditure of the vehicle i.e. major and minor rep airs, spares, engine oil, lubricants, all other consumables etc is included in the valu e of PO. No extra payment whatsoever will be claimable under the contract. 8. It is estimated that each vehicle on an average shall run for 2500 kilometres/mont h. However if the vehicle runs less kilometre than prescribed during the month, the balance kilometre can be carried forward to upcoming months but not more than 0 6 months duration. During any month vehicle may exceed above prescribed limit o f distance if required and the contractor shall be bound to provide the vehicle in ca se of excess distance also. Log Book to be maintained by the service provider and the same to be signed by Railway Authority from time to time. 9. The Railway Administration reserves the right to decrease or increase the duratio n period of hiring or terminate the contract at any point of time without assigning any reason for such curtailment or increase in the period; and contractor will not b e entitled for any compensation or claim what-so-ever. The said decrease or increa se the duration period of hiring or termination of the contract will be governed by l atest GCC for Services, 2018. 10.The driver of the vehicle will maintain a logbook for entry of distance travelled. Re porting time & release time shall be recorded in the log book every day and same will be certified by the concerned officer/official. It will be the responsibility of the driver of the vehicle to ensure proper distance record in the log book and should g et signed from the officers/officials controlling the vehicle. 11.The vehicle should be registered as commercial vehicles. The make year of the v ehicle should not be more than 03 years (i.e. make year should be 2024 & after) a nd should not have run more than 25000 km at the time of start of contract, howe ver it may be considered by the railway authority, based on the condition of the ca r. 12.The contractor shall ensure that all the meters particularly distance meter (i.e. kil ometre) and other devices of the vehicles are in proper working condition. In case of any defect develops and is pointed out by the Railway authority, repair/replace ment of the same should be carried out immediately by the service provider at his /her own cost, failing which penalty will be imposed. The contractor shall also ensu re that enough fuel is available in the vehicles all the time. Bill payment should be on the basis of the log book maintained by the service provider duly certified by th e railway authority. 13.In the event of en-route breakdown of the vehicle, contractor has to provide ano ther similar vehicle within 01 (one) hour at the place of breakdown, failing which p enalty may be levied at the discretion of the Railway Authority. Standby vehicle sh all be kept on reserve for using during breakdown of the existing vehicle. 14.To avoid any mishaps or accident during the operation of vehicle the contractor s hall ensure that only skilled, efficient driver with sufficient driving experience is de ployed on the job and is not put to over exertion as per labour law. The driver mus t possess valid commercial driving license issued by the transport authority. In cas e of any accident or mishap resulting in loss of damage to property or life, the sole responsibility for any legal or financial implication shall rest with contractor.

15.The contractor shall provide a good condition spare wheel and standard tools kit f or the vehicle. 16.The driver should be in neat and clean white uniform with name badge. The nam e badge indicating name and designation should be worn by the driver during work ing. The firm has to provide attested copies of valid driving license and Bio-data of all the drivers deputed for vehicle well in advance to Railway Administration. 17.After the normal/schedule duty hours, the driver shall be contactable so that in c ase of any emergency the vehicle can be called in a short notice of 01(one) hour. It shall be the responsibility of the contractor to provide the vehicle at a notice of 01( one) hour after call. The contractor’s driver should have telephone/mobile facilities so that they can be contacted. The contractor shall at his own cost maintain round the clock of drivers that must carry valid driving license all the time. The contracto r shall be responsible for satisfactory service of the driver. In any case, the Railway Administration is not satisfied with the conduct of any driver provided by the contr actor, the contractor shall have to replace the driver on being advised by the Railw ay Authority. 18.The contractor is required to maintain the vehicle in excellent condition at his ow n cost. The vehicle should be cleaned thoroughly on daily basis. The seats shall be covered with white towel, seat covers (or as advised by official using the vehicle) a nd which should be cleaned once a “fortnight”. 19. Bharat Stage: The vehicle shall comply BHARAT STAGE-VI (six) or latest standard and should have good appearance and riding comfort. 20. The vehicle shall confirm the norms of West Bengal Pollution Control Board and o ther statutory requirements. Onus of that lies entirely upon the contractor for whic h no extra charge will be paid by the Railway. 21.The hired vehicle should have proper Registration and comply with all the Rules & Regulations of Motor Vehicle Act/Rules. Vehicle should have valid license/permit fo r west Bengal state issued by the registration office of West Bengal. The Railways shall not accept any liability in this matter. 22.The offered vehicle should have valid insurance as per RTO’s Rules & Regulations . The driver put on job by the contractor must always possess attested photo copy of registration of the vehicle, valid road tax challan, valid insurance documents an d valid PUC certificate and should produce them to the Railway Authority as and w hen required. 23. Payments to RTO, labour authorities, permit charges and local municipal authorit ies. Taxes, levies, fees, insurance charges, emission, PUC Certificate and all other charges, which are necessary for the continuance of the services under the contrac t shall be borne by the contractor. 24. In case of any accident, the contractor will have to take all liabilities; no compens ation will be made by the Railway authority. 25. Whenever required, necessary equipment, material shall have to be carried by t he vehicle. However, in case any unauthorised materials are found in the vehicle, t

he responsibility shall solely rest with the contractor for the same. 26. The price shall include all taxes, levies, handling charges etc. what-so-ever appli cable. 27.Terms of Payment:- After fulfilling all terms and condition mentioned in GCC of service 2018 and MSOP 2018 or modified thereafter contractor will submit bills with all requisite document to the office of Dy. CME(LHB)/LLH. Subsequently bill will be passed and payment w ill be done by the respective authority. Dy. CME(LHB)/LLH is the bill passing authori ty and Dy.CAO(W)/LLH or WAO(IC)/LLH is the bill paying authority. Shramikkalyan Web Railway Portal:- Contractor is to abide by and ensure complian ce to statutory provisions of applicable Labour Laws and various Labour Legislation s, as applicable. In order to ensure the same, an application has been developed a nd hosted on website ‘www.shramikkalyan.indianrailways.gov.in’. Contractor shall register his firm/company etc. and upload requisite details of labour and their pay ment in this portal. These details shall be available in public domain. The registrati on/updation of Portal shall be done as under: a) Contractor shall apply for onetime registration of his company/firm etc. in the Shramikkalyan Portal with requisite details subsequent to issue of Letter of Ac ceptance. The Competent Railway Authority shall approve the contractor’s regi stration on the portal within 7 days of receipt of such request. b) Contractor once approved by the Competent Railway Authority, can create pa ssword with login ID (PAN No.) for subsequent use of portal for all LOA’s issued in his favour. c) The contractor once registered on the portal, shall provided details of his Lett er of Acceptance (LOA)/ Contract Agreements on Shramikkalyan Portal within 1 5 days of issue of any LOA for approval of concerned Railway Authority and sh all update (if required) and approve the details of LOA filled by contractor withi n 7 days of receipt of such request. d) After approval of LOA by Railway Authority, contractor shall fill the salient det ails of contract labours engaged in the contract and ensure updating of each w age payment to them on Shramikkalyan Portal on monthly basis. e) It shall be mandatory upon the contractor to ensure correct and prompt uplo ading of all salient details of engaged contractual labour& payments made the reof after each wage period. f) While processing payment of any ‘On Account Bill’ or ‘Final Bill’ or release of ‘ Advances’ or ‘Performance Guarantee/ Security Deposit’ etc. contractor has to submit a certificate regarding uploading/updating of the correct details of cont ract labourers engaged in connection with the subject contract and payments made during the wage period in Railway’s Shramikkalyan portal at ‘’www.shra mikkalyan.indianrailways.gov.in’’ till........ Month.......... Year............ 28. PENALTY CLAUSE: i. In case the supplied vehicle is other than the make/model mentioned in the ten der document, penalty @ Rs.3000/ per day will be imposed. ii. The contractor shall ensure that the vehicle is available on all 7(Seven) days of

the week. In case of non availability of vehicles, Rs.5000/ per day will be impos ed as penalty. iii.For improper behaviour of the driver Rs. 1000/- will be imposed as penalty per reported cases. iv. The contractor shall ensure that all the meters particularly for distance (i.e. Kil ometre), Fuel and other devices of the vehicle are in proper working condition. I n case any defect develops and are pointed out by Railway authority, necessary repairs and replacement should be carried out immediately by the contractor at his own cost, failing which penalty of Rs. 500.00 (Rupees Five Hundred) only pe r day will be levied at the discretion of the Railway authority. The contractor sh all also ensure that enough fuel is available in the fuel tank of the vehicle all the time, failing which Rs.1000/- per case will be imposed as penalty v. In the event of breakdown of the vehicle during the course of operation, contra ctor has to provide another similar vehicle within 01 (one) hour at the place of b reakdown, failing which a penalty of double the proportionate daily rate may be levied at the discretion of the Railway Authority. Standby vehicle be kept spare for use during the time of breakdown of the existing vehicle. vi. For violation of any contractual agreement Rs.1000/- will be imposed as penalt y. 29. Dress code: Dress code of the driver should be as per guide line issued by this w orkshop time to time 30. Police Verification of Labour employed by Contractor: The contractor is required to submit Police Verification certificates for all contra ctual staff that she/he will be hiring for delivery of services for Indian Railways. Police verification can now be done through the online portal digitalpolice.gov.i n, where police verification reports are generated following the standard proced ure by the respective police authority. Tender document (Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC) and Scope of Work will be treated as the integral part of this tender.
